fullDescription: An editorial report deck in two flat inks, where a single colour band relocates to a different edge of the frame on every slide and the ink inverts with it. Cover and closer are bookended by a condensed poster word cut clean off by the frame edge. Nine named layouts so a deck of any length has somewhere to put every slide.

Cover and closer are bookended by a condensed poster word cut clean off by the frame edge. Nine named layouts so a deck of any length has somewhere to put every slide.","style":{"description":"Printed civic survey: a harbour authority annual return or a small-press field journal, set in two inks.","prompt":"Exactly three values, all used as INK, never as a decorative tint: putty #E5DCC8, deep pine #27412F, and one mid-sage #8b9484 for recessive ghost layers only. No white, no black, no fourth colour. Every colour field is FLAT: no gradient, no radial wash, no film grain, no box-shadow, no glow. Emphasis comes from scale and from inverting the ink across a field boundary, never from an accent spike on a neutral ground. Two typefaces with strictly separate jobs: Bebas Neue (condensed) for all display and all figures, Instrument Sans for every piece of functional text (labels, body, captions). Constant furniture on all slides: an 18px uppercase label at 0.2em tracking in each of the four corners, hairline rules at 1px and 30% opacity, and a page counter bottom-right. Left margin 86px and right margin 86px on every slide with no exceptions."},"layout_and_structure":{"description":"One flat pine band per slide, relocated each time. Nine layouts; a deck uses cover, closer, and whichever middles the content needs.","cover":"Pine band across the top 648px. Inside it: corner labels, a pure-SVG illustration at right, a 19px uppercase kicker and a 27px/1.5 standfirst no wider than 700px. Below the band on putty, the deck's one-word title in Bebas at 392px, positioned bottom:-92px so the frame physically slices the baseline. A 196px hairline circle seal bottom-right. SIZE THE POSTER WORD FROM ITS CHARACTER COUNT: 392px fits 7 condensed characters across 1920px. Add roughly one character per 55px removed. Never leave it at a heading default.","statement_stat":"Band re-cut as a LEFT COLUMN 560px wide, full height, carrying a 23px/1.55 method note in putty at 70% opacity. On the putty side: a 19px uppercase kicker, then the figure in Bebas at 380px, then a hairline running the full measure out to the right margin, then a 34px/1.45 sentence that the figure grammatically begins.","list":"Band re-cut as a THIN TOP RULE 148px deep carrying the corner labels. Bebas head at 132px, a 30px/1.5 standfirst, then 3 to 5 items separated by hairlines. Each item is a 74px Bebas ordinal in sage, a 40px name, and a 21px/1.4 note. Give the rows a min-height so a one-line note does not make its row shorter than the others.","comparison":"Band re-cut as a RIGHT COLUMN 960px wide for a true 50/50 split, inks inverted across the seam. Each half: a Bebas figure at 210px optically hung to its own margin, a 22px/1.5 caption, then 4 mirrored stat rows separated by hairlines with a 22px label left and a Bebas value at 54px right. Both halves must use identical inner margins and identical row positions.","data_table":"Band inverted to a BOTTOM strip 148px deep. Bebas head at 150px (the second line may be set in sage). A 23px/1.55 method note top-right. Then a table on a 112px / 1fr / 560px / 176px grid: 52px Bebas ordinal in sage, 31px semibold name, 20px note, 52px Bebas figure right-aligned with tabular numerals. Hairline above every row and below the last. Leave at least 100px between the head and the first rule, and between the last rule and the band.","quote":"NO band; the one open putty field in the deck. A short hairline, then the quote in Instrument Sans at 64px/1.35 across no more than 1150px, then a 30px name and a 21px/1.5 biographical line. A Bebas date stamp at 196px in sage at 22% sits right, right-aligned as a stack with both lines optically flush.","section_break":"Full pine field. A Bebas section word at 280px, optically centred, with the section ordinal at 112px in putty at 34% directly above it. Corner labels only, no body copy.","closer":"Full pine field, inks inverted. The closing poster word in Bebas at 392px positioned top:-104px so the frame slices it from ABOVE, mirroring the cover. A 29px/1.56 forward-looking paragraph, a 112px Bebas stamp right at 34% opacity, a short hairline, and a 20px/1.6 colophon. Break the colophon on a clause so the last line is never a runt.","global_rules":["EVERY generated slide must be one of the named layouts above. A slide that is an unstyled heading plus a paragraph is a failed slide.","If content exceeds a layout, SPLIT it into more slides. Never shrink the type to make it fit."]},"implementation_notes":"Single self-contained HTML file. Zero external dependencies except one Google Fonts <link>; all imagery inline SVG or base64. Fixed 1920x1080 stage scaled as a whole (letterbox, never reflow): .deck-stage is 1920x1080 with transform-origin 0 0, scaled by Math.min(innerWidth/1920, innerHeight/1080) and centred, recomputed on resize. Slides are .slide with .slide.active as the only visible one. Fixed internal measurements only: no clamp(), no media-query breakpoints inside the stage. SET THE LETTERBOX BACKGROUND DELIBERATELY from the deck's own palette (--stage-bg:#27412F here); mobile and tablet previews show more of that field than of the deck. ENTRANCE CHOREOGRAPHY on every slide, keyed to .slide.active only, never to hover: elements carry class=\"reveal\" with a --i stagger index, driven by --reveal-duration:.56s, --reveal-ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), --reveal-distance:34px, --reveal-stagger:78ms. The grammar for this register is staggered text reveals of 500 to 700ms on ease-out-expo, VERTICAL TRAVEL ONLY at 40px or less, no overshoot and no scale; the poster headline lands first at --i:0 and the corner furniture last. NAV CONTRACT: keyboard (arrows, space, PageUp/PageDown, Home, End), touch swipe via touchstart/touchend with a 40px threshold, throttled wheel, and click (right two thirds forward, left third back), plus an on-screen slide counter. Put the counter in a CORNER, not bottom-centre, and give it a deck-settable mid-tone colour: bottom-centre is where frame-cut headlines live and the counter renders straight through the hero word. @media print: one slide per page, all slides visible, reveals forced settled, chrome hidden, so Print to PDF just works. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): collapse the choreography to a plain fade."}
